allies.rationale_text: Decision-trees helps category-decisions separate cases and consequences before the rule is locked in.
allies.source_quote: decision trees are tools used to cleave a problem into insightful parts
allies.affinity_rationale: Practical structuring tool — 'tools used to cleave a problem into insightful parts' — provides the analytical cut for category separation but operates as one framework among several rather than being constitutive of the categorization process.
allies.activation_condition: When category boundaries need to be validated by explicitly mapping the branching logic that separates cases and their consequences before the categorization rule is locked in

allies.rationale_text: Checklists strengthens category-decisions by turning stable boundaries into repeatable operational moves instead of ad hoc improvisation.
allies.source_quote: stable decision rule rather than case-by-case improvisation
allies.affinity_rationale: Operational consistency tool — 'stable decision rule rather than case-by-case improvisation' — converts validated categories into repeatable execution but is downstream of the categorization decision itself.
allies.activation_condition: When validated category boundaries need to be operationalized into consistent, repeatable sorting rules that prevent ad hoc improvisation across cases

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias distorts category-decisions when the bucket is defended for political comfort instead of evidence.
antagonists.source_quote: predisposition to defend existing beliefs or mental models
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly blocks objective review — 'predisposition to defend existing beliefs or mental models' — fights against the evidence-based reassessment that category decisions require, causing categories to be defended for comfort rather than accuracy.
antagonists.activation_condition: When existing category assignments are being defended based on political comfort or familiarity rather than subjected to the objective evidence-based review that accurate categorization requires

structured_tensions.tension_text: Category-decisions conflicts with representativeness-heuristic when labels are assigned from salient traits instead of distributional evidence.
structured_tensions.source_quote: category-decisions vs representativeness-heuristic: labels are assigned from salient traits instead of distributional evidence.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Category-decisions conflicts with first-principles-thinking when inherited buckets replace decomposition of underlying mechanisms.
structured_tensions.source_quote: category-decisions vs first-principles-thinking: inherited buckets replace decomposition of underlying mechanisms.
